# MaxWithdrawExecutor

## MaxWithdrawExecutor
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/misc/MaxWithdrawExecutor.sol)

**Title:**
MaxWithdrawExecutor

Allows a designated keeper to withdraw the maximum available assets from a hardcoded
ERC-4626 vault on behalf of a hardcoded owner, sending underlying tokens directly to them.

PREREQUISITE: The OWNER must approve this contract to spend their vault shares before
execute() can be called. Call `vault.approve(thisContract, type(uint256).max)` from OWNER.


### State Variables
#### VAULT
Hardcoded vault (ERC-4626) and beneficiary (treasury) addresses


```solidity
address public constant VAULT = 0x2433D6AC11193b4695D9ca73530de93c538aD18a
```


#### OWNER

```solidity
address public constant OWNER = 0x447BF9d1485ABDc4C1778025DfdfbE8b894C3796
```


#### keeper
Contract owner (deployer)


```solidity
address public immutable keeper
```


### Functions
#### constructor


```solidity
constructor(address _keeper) ;
```

#### onlyKeeper


```solidity
modifier onlyKeeper() ;
```

#### currentMaxWithdraw

View the current max withdrawable assets for OWNER from VAULT


```solidity
function currentMaxWithdraw() external view returns (uint256);
```

#### execute

Withdraws the full currently-allowed assets to OWNER

Requires OWNER to have previously approved this contract on the vault


```solidity
function execute() external onlyKeeper returns (uint256 sharesBurned);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`sharesBurned`|`uint256`|The number of vault shares burned|


#### rescueToken

Rescues ERC20 tokens mistakenly sent to this contract


```solidity
function rescueToken(address token, uint256 amount, address to) external onlyKeeper;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|The ERC20 token address to rescue|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount to transfer|
|`to`|`address`|Destination address|
